name: motif_compose_batch
description:
Compose many intents. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Use only if one grammar question needs several intents in one Draft; otherwise call the typed composer. A forEach repeating one change over many stems usually belongs in an inflection class, phonological rule, natural class or stem name (guide workflow). Stages every intent in a JSON file in one Draft with one project load, through the same checks as each composing command alone. If any intent is refused, nothing is added, and both a label and a Rationale are still required before Finalize. Only a person can Apply. The report lists the first 25 operations and says how to read the rest with show.
Command: compose-batch. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentsJson: {"intents":[{"verb":"compose-author-phoneme","intent":{...},"citation":{"source":"Grammar","locator":"§ 3"}}, ...]}: each entry names a composing verb, carries exactly the closed intent that verb's --intent takes, and may include one citation beside that intent.
BaseDirectory: The folder a forEachtargetsFile path is read from, normally the folder of the batch file; the a targetsFile is refused when absent, as over MCP, where callers pass targets inline.

foldStressMarks.description: When true, omit newForm: it is computed from expectedForm by removing U+0300, U+0301, U+0302, U+0304 and U+030C only. This destructive spelling fold is not phonological realization; use false and explicit newForm when distinctions condition grammar.

locator.description: Optional page, section or other source location.

targets.description: Ids or forms; the entry becomes one intent per target, with {target}, {target.id} and {target.form} replaced in its strings.

forEach.description: Use only if each target is a listed exception; otherwise one change on many stems belongs in an inflection class, phonological rule, natural class or stem name.

target.description: Existing ordinary alternate form ID; lexeme forms use compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.

expectedForm.description: Current text required for this edit, compared by canonical Unicode equivalence.

newForm.description: Replacement, or an empty string to clear this alternative; no accent, quantity or segment folding is performed.
